title: Suspect in Cambridge Planet Fitness assault knew victim, assaulted employee who tried to help, prosecutors say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Crime Police found the suspect putting his clothes back on in the locker room after the alleged assaults, prosecutors said.

The sex offender arrested in connection with the alleged sexual assault in the women’s locker room at a Cambridge Planet Fitness last week knew the victim and attacked an employee who attempted to intervene, prosecutors said.

Laquan Holland, 40, is charged with two counts of assault to rape, two counts of indecent assault and battery on a person over 14, one count of kidnapping, and one count of witness intimidation, court records show.
